hooks: SwimInputOverride ok (Active ok, Steer ok, JumpRequested ok); BennyController ok (Instance ok, S ok, LateralX ok, TeleportTo(float,float) ok); Screen05Events ok (CoinCollected ok, Finished ok, BennyS ok)
notes: coinsCollected counts Screen05Events.CoinCollected while the autopilot ran. ringsPassedBySpacing assumes rings at multiples of RiverPath.RingSpacing; ringsPassedSceneObjects counts renderers named *ring* that are thin in Z and wide in X (0 when the rings are one combined mesh). Lateral values are Benny's world X. Check that the clip plays upright; if not, record again with flipVertical = true.
